eval: (async () => { await import('/sandbox/campaign_interior.js'); await CI.ready(); const L = await (await fetch('/levels/gildhaven.json')).json(); L.objects.push({ id: 'mill_door', type: 'entrance', x: 64, z: 119.5, name: 'mill-door', facing: 'up' }, { id: 'exit_cellar', type: 'exit', minX: 63, maxX: 65, minZ: 121, maxZ: 122, to: 'mill-cellar', entrance: 'from-mill', mode: 'use', label: 'Enter' }, { id: 'ci_crates', type: 'crateStack', x: 68.5, z: 120.5, when: 'ci-crates' }, { id: 'ci_lamp', type: 'lamppost', x: 59.5, z: 120.5, unless: 'ci-crates' }); return window.__luminati.playLocal(L, 'ci-gildhaven', 'campaign=ferrymans-lantern&as=millbrook&autostart=1&new=1'); })()

(async () => { await import('/sandbox/campaign_interior.js'); const r = await CI.ready(); const g = __game.game; const s = __game.state(); CI.groupOf = (id) => { const o = g.level.objects.find((x) => x.id === id); return o ? __game.game.world.storyGroups.get(`${String(o.when ?? '').trim()}�${String(o.unless ?? '').trim()}`) : null; }; CI.lampHidden = () => { const grp = CI.groupOf('ci_lamp'); const W = __game.game.world; return !!grp && grp.poolLights.length > 0 && grp.poolLights.every((d) => W.lightPool.isHidden(d)); }; CI.expect(s.campaign.level === 'millbrook' && g.level.width === 128, 'Gildhaven plays as Millbrook'); CI.expect(CI.groupOf('ci_crates') && !CI.groupOf('ci_crates').present && CI.groupOf('ci_lamp')?.present && !CI.lampHidden(), 'the story crates absent, the lamp there'); return JSON.stringify({ ...r, size: [g.level.width, g.level.depth], objects: g.level.objects.length, memory: CI.gpu(), scene: CI.sceneSize(), loadStats: g.loadStats }); })()

(async () => { const c = __game.game.campaign; c.keepRooms = false; CI.hashOn = false; const out = []; for (const wait of [0, 0, 2000, 2000]) { out.push(await CI.trip('exit_cellar', { wait: 0, label: 'before: town→cellar' })); out.push(await CI.trip('exit_stairs', { wait, label: 'before: cellar→town' })); } CI.expect(out.every((t) => t.ok && t.kept === false), 'without keeping (keepRooms false): every travel builds'); c.keepRooms = true; CI.hashOn = true; return JSON.stringify(out.map((t) => ({ route: t.route, waited: t.waitedMs, travelMs: t.travelMs, buildMs: t.buildMs, prepUsed: t.prepUsed, phases: t.phases, programs: [t.programsAtArrival, t.programsAfterPlay], frames: t.frames.max }))); })()

CI.trip('exit_cellar').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'mill-cellar' && r.kept === false, 'into the cellar (built: nothing was kept before)'); CI.expect(r.aside.length === 1 && r.aside[0].slot === 'parent' && r.aside[0].level === 'millbrook', 'the 128 × 128 town set aside'); return JSON.stringify(r); })

CI.trip('exit_stairs').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'millbrook' && r.kept === true && r.sameHash === true, 'the 128 × 128 town attached again at once, as it was left'); CI.expect(r.aside.length === 1 && r.aside[0].slot === 'room', 'the cellar kept as the last room'); return JSON.stringify(r); })

CI.trip('exit_cellar', { wait: 2000 }).then(async (r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === true && r.sameHash === true, 'the cellar attached again (after waiting)'); __game.campaign.setFlag('ci-crates'); await CI.sleep(300); return JSON.stringify(r); })

CI.trip('exit_stairs', { wait: 2000 }).then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === true, 'the town attached again (after waiting)'); const crates = CI.groupOf('ci_crates'); CI.expect(crates?.present && __game.game.world.tileMap.colliders.some((c) => crates.colliders.includes(c)), 'a flag set in the room: the story crates there on return (shown, colliders in)'); CI.expect(!CI.groupOf('ci_lamp')?.present && CI.lampHidden(), 'and the lamp gone (its light hidden in the pool)'); return JSON.stringify(r); })
CI.trip('exit_cellar').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === true && r.sameHash === true, 'the cellar again, at once'); return JSON.stringify(r); })
CI.trip('exit_stairs').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === true && r.sameHash === true, 'the town again, at once'); return JSON.stringify(r); })
CI.trip('exit_cellar').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === true && r.sameHash === true, 'the cellar, at once'); return JSON.stringify(r); })
CI.trip('exit_stairs').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === true && r.sameHash === true, 'the town, at once'); return JSON.stringify(r); })

(() => { const after = CI.trips.filter((t) => !t.route.startsWith('before')); const town = after.filter((t) => t.level === 'millbrook'); const cellar = after.filter((t) => t.level === 'mill-cellar'); const one = (a) => new Set(a).size === 1; const key = (t) => JSON.stringify([t.scene, t.programsAtArrival]); CI.expect(one(town.slice(1).map(key)) && one(town.slice(1).map((t) => JSON.stringify(t.memory))), 'the town: the same GPU memory, scene and programs after every return (no leak): ' + town.map((t) => key(t) + JSON.stringify(t.memory)).join(' ')); CI.expect(one(cellar.slice(1).map(key)) && one(cellar.slice(1).map((t) => JSON.stringify(t.memory))), 'the cellar: the same GPU memory, scene and programs on every return: ' + cellar.map((t) => key(t) + JSON.stringify(t.memory)).join(' ')); CI.expect(CI.trips.every((t) => t.programsAtArrival === t.programsAfterPlay), 'no program compiled after any arrival'); CI.expect(CI.trips.every((t) => t.lights === 12), '12 point lights everywhere'); const kept = after.filter((t) => t.kept); CI.expect(kept.length === 7 && kept.every((t) => t.buildMs <= 300 && t.travelMs <= 650), 'a level set aside comes back in the fades plus at most 0.3 s: ' + kept.map((t) => t.travelMs + '/' + t.buildMs).join(' ')); CI.expect(kept.every((t) => t.prepBefore === null && t.prepUsed === null), 'nothing built ahead toward a level set aside: ' + kept.map((t) => t.prepBefore).join(' ')); CI.expect(town.every((t) => t.npcs.present === t.npcs.all && t.npcs.animated >= 1) && town.reduce((n, t) => n + t.npcs.moved, 0) >= 1, 'the villagers there, animated and walking on after every return'); localStorage.removeItem('luminati.level.ci-gildhaven'); return JSON.stringify(CI.summary()); })()
